name: Four Seasons Hotel Florence
positioning: Four Seasons hotel set within two Renaissance palaces in the centre of Florence, next to a large private garden
best_for: Travelers who want a historic palace setting with frescoed suites
Guests who want the Duomo and Uffizi Gallery within a 10 to 15 minute walk

facts.text: Four Seasons Hotel Firenze is set within two Renaissance palaces.
The hotel's address is Borgo Pinti 99.
Palazzo della Gherardesca was built in 1473 by Bartolomeo Scala.
The Duomo, the Uffizi Gallery and the Accademia Gallery are a 10 to 15 minutes' walk away.
Il Palagio is the hotel's Michelin-starred restaurant.
The Spa is 791 sq m (8,511 sq ft).
The hotel's interior designer is Pierre Yves Rochon.
The hotel has an enclosed 4.5-hectare (11-acre) park with walking and jogging paths.

highlights.text: The suites feature frescoes and original architectural details.
The Garden Suite has a private pool (seasonal).
The Duomo View Executive Suite is a bi-level suite with sweeping views of the Duomo and Florence's rooftops.
Guests can book a dinner on the Ponte Vecchio, on a terrace reserved just for guests of the hotel.
A tasting-menu dinner is offered in the hotel's Renaissance chapel, decorated with original frescoes.
Every Sunday, Il Palagio hosts a gourmet buffet brunch.

considerations.text: Onde is listed as temporarily closed on the hotel's dining page.
The Garden Suite's private pool is seasonal.
Golf is an off-site activity, 30 minutes away.
WhataHotel notes historic building constraints on room size variations.
